config.hypothesis: the frozen production planner beats fixed, random and coverage views on actual hidden-state error under matched budgets

frozen_planner.git_commit_note: git rev-parse HEAD at freeze time; the frozen code is the UNCOMMITTED working tree whose parent is this commit (the agent cannot commit)
frozen_planner.mission_note: the integrated runtime supplies no PredictiveBelief (Model2T messages carry no variances), so in missions the ranker uses its documented fallback value: the analytic MCBR mission value divided by (cost_floor + cost_weight * cost)

selection.note: conventional Bayesian EIG per unit cost won on validation; per the brief it becomes the production planner behind the MCBR interface. Its lead over A-B6b and A-B11 is not significant (paired CI includes 0).
